[[Vault-Tec Corporation]] (possibly) |role = |TV actor = }} The '''man in shadows'''{{Ref|(Note)}} or '''shadowy figure'''"''Barb gets a message on her Pip-Boy. She reads it, then looks up at the SHADOWY FIGURE in the booth overlooking the room.''"
("[[The Beginning]]" episode script) is a [[Fallout TV series#Cast and characters|character]] {{In|FOTV}}. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Beginning]]=== Apparently associated with the [[Vault-Tec Corporation]] as well as occupying a position of high power, the man is seen observing the pre-[[Great War|War]] landmark meeting between Vault-Tec executives [[Barb Howard]] and [[Bud Askins]] along with other prominent corporate leaders, such as [[Robert House]], [[Frederick Sinclair]], [[Julia Masters]], and [[Leon Von Felden]], from a dark observation room above. When the participants of the meeting start to argue, Barb receives a message from her [[Pip-Boy]] and looks up at the [[spectator]]s, with the man seated behind them; the contents of the message are unknown.''At the meeting, Barb checks her Pip-Boy. She looks up towards spectators watching from a dark balcony. Behind them, a man stands in shadows in an observation room.''
("[[The Beginning]]" audio description) ==Notes== {{Note|(Note)}} The character's name

march_sherwood_raw.json.text:
{{Infobox character |games =FOTV |image =FOTV Vault 31 Cryobay.png |race =[[Human]] |gender =Male/Female |family = |location =[[Vault 31]] |role =Junior executive |affiliation =[[Vault 31]]/[[Vault-Tec Corporation]] |TV actor = |dod = |dod verified= }} '''March Sherwood''' is a pre-War junior executive of the [[Vault-Tec Corporation]] who is currently preserved in [[Vault 31]]. ==Background== Sherwood was a Vault-Tec junior employee selected to participate in [[Bud Askins]]' executive assistant training program "[[Bud's Buds]]," a plan to create "super managers" who would define the future of humanity after the [[Great War]] wiped out all competitors to Vault-Tec. Sherwood and the other Buds would be kept in [[Cryonics|cryostasis]] in Vault 31, periodically thawed out and transferred to [[Vault 32]] or [[Vault 33|33]] to manage the dwellers and participate in controlled breeding (eugenics), all under Askins' supervision.[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"So what's Vault 32 and 33? Just people to be controlled?"''
[[Bud Askins]]: ''"What? No! When you put it like that, it sounds downright morally questionable. They're our breeding pool, the ultimate expression of HR R&D. Genetically selected to breed with my Buds to create a class of super managers. People with positivity, people who make lemonade. People who will inherit the Earth after we've wiped the surface clean."''
("[[The Beginning]]")
